a.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operate together until the reserve reaches 8, then take 4 each. I know the storm risk is high, but if we both operate in round 1 we reach 6, and 8 after round 2. I won't take early. Let's keep each other informed honestly.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Once the reserve hits 8, we each take exactly 4.
